findings.detail: Rows from the Unfunded Balances table are being counted as FV-bearing investment leaves even though the source columns are period unfunded-balance amounts, not Fair Value.

rationale: B01 is an aggregate coverage flag: 469 of 537 leaves have fair_value. The current SOI schedule has an explicit Fair Value column and the filing total investments row is 210,055,893, which agrees with the extracted FV total at the same scale apart from a small rounding/extraction delta. The residual no-FV rows localize to separate Unfunded Balances tables whose headers are Issuer, Maturity, December 31, 2025, and December 31, 2024; those rows do not present fair value. Counting these unfunded-balance rows as FV-bearing holdings leaves is therefore a real classification/scope extraction error, not a missing fair-value number in the SOI.
